model.state_order: X1,...,X9; index binary most-significant bit X1
model.transition: same synchronous lactose rules and independent node5/node9 draws; no forced absorption until observed first hit
model.training_initial_distribution: independent uniform binary vector on all512 states at every reset, including target
model.evaluation_initial_design: exactly four independent trajectories per state, integer states0..511 in increasing order; uniform-start estimator uses weight1/512 per state
model.stopping: check initial target before requesting action; thereafter check target after every plant step; stop immediately at hit or H=100, whichever first
model.terminal_hold: execute only until first hit or horizon; count initiating update once; retain selected tau and realized ell; no remainder dynamics, reward, input cost or further update

training.exact_training_plant_steps: policy-dependent; record actual, not capped maximum
training.initial_target_training_episode: count completed episode, zero decisions and zero plant transitions; no TD/actor/dual increment except advance episode schedule

evaluation.endpoint_record: same terminal checkpoint evaluation as table endpoint
evaluation.exact_reference: deterministic DP and constrained finite-horizon occupation formulation evaluated by exact killed kernels; rollout descriptive statistics separately labelled

objectives.displayed_rate: E[K]/E[T_cap], estimated ratio of totals, not E[K/T_cap]
objectives.not_equivalent: not minimizing uncensored infinite-horizon hitting time; not maximizing continuing occupancy; not an objective-matched comparison to the lactose mean-field study

exact_model.macro_cost: E[ell]+0.01*L1(u)*E[ell]+100*Pr(failure at horizon during this macro)
exact_model.survival_kernel: probability of surviving ell=min(tau,remaining) plant steps without hitting target and remaining>ell, with endpoint x_next; no continuation after hit/horizon
exact_model.unconstrained_reference: backward dynamic programming for tau1 and full action set separately; primary cost, then expected K, then lowest canonical action index
exact_model.constrained_reference: nonnegative finite-horizon expected decision occupation; initial non-target mass1/512 each, killed-kernel flow, minimize expected cost subject sum y*(1-Gamma*Eell)<=0; zero-time initial target contributes zero. Allows randomized time-augmented policy.
exact_model.zero_mass_policy: lowest canonical action index; initial-law objective and feasibility checked after recovery
exact_model.constrained_reference_tie_break: after minimum cost Jstar, minimize expected updates with cost<=Jstar+1e-10 and the same flow/budget constraints; save chosen occupation and solver options; no unsupported uniqueness claim

Macro_Q.behavior: epsilon uniform exploration over20 actions, otherwise lowest-index minimizing action
Macro_Q.evaluation: greedy Q-min, lowest action index on ties

PD_SMAC_FA.label: new episodic semi-Markov primal-dual actor-critic adaptation
PD_SMAC_FA.actor: softmax row W[x,remaining,:], temperature1; zero-sum-box bound12
PD_SMAC_FA.critic: tabular V[x,remaining], terminal value0; V initialized0
PD_SMAC_FA.actor_timing: freeze actor and lambda during episode; accumulate sum(delta*(onehot-p)) per visited row; apply one projected row update at episode end, without division by K
PD_SMAC_FA.average_reward_eta: not used in this explicitly stopping adaptation
PD_SMAC_FA.scope: finite empirical episodic learner; no continuing convergence theorem or KKT certificate claimed
